authors: Y. Chen, E. Patelli, B. Edwards, M. Beer
title: Bayesian Augmented-Learning framework for spectral uncertainty quantification of incomplete records of stochastic processes
contribution_summary: Proposes a Bayesian RNN/Autoencoder framework trained via stochastic variational inference to quantify spectral uncertainty and waveform error in incomplete stochastic process time series.
missingness_assumption: MCAR (Missing Completely at Random, simulated via uniform random draw of binary mask vector)

authors: Z. Chang, S. Liu, R. Qiu, S. Song, Z. Cai, G. Tu
title: Time-aware neural ordinary differential equations for incomplete time series modeling
contribution_summary: Proposes a continuous Neural ODE model (TN-ODE) with a time-aware LSTM encoder for irregular time series interpolation and prediction, focusing on minimizing point-estimate errors (MSE/RMSE/MAE).
missingness_assumption: MCAR (Observed values to eliminate are selected completely at random and independently)

authors: S. Sharma, P. Lingras, M. Zhong
title: Effect of missing values estimations on traffic parameters
contribution_summary: Evaluates factor models, ARIMA, and GA-designed regression/neural networks for imputing permanent traffic count time series, analyzing impacts on annual summary statistics (AADT and DHV).
missingness_assumption: Unstated formally (tested on continuous blocks of pseudo-missing hourly traffic data)

authors: X. Chen, H. Wang, H. Gao, Y. Liu, Z. Pan, Q. Song, H. Qin
title: Prior-Knowledge-Guided Missing Data Imputation for Bridge Cracks: A Temperature-Driven SP-VMD-CNN-GRU Framework
contribution_summary: Combines Granger causality tests and Shared-Period VMD with a CNN-GRU network to impute bridge crack width time series using temperature as a physical driver.
missingness_assumption: Unstated formally (treated as real-world sensor/communication failure in continuous monitoring)

authors: B. Li, L. Long, X. Zuo, L. Chen
title: Conditional Diffusion Model for Missing Value Imputation
contribution_summary: Introduces a conditional diffusion model (CDMVI) for missing value imputation in tabular/numerical datasets, focusing on empirical RMSE reduction and downstream classification.
missingness_assumption: MCAR (discussed MCAR, MAR, MNAR conceptually; evaluated on MCAR random deletion and spatial masks)
